title: tui: one meaning per hue
body: Ids cyan everywhere, including inside 'waits on'. Priority and status as now. Kind magenta for a milestone, dim otherwise. A person's name cyan and an agent's magenta, on rows and in posts. Times dim. The pane holding the cursor gets a plain border and a bright title. Section headers and the title line bold cyan. A rollup green once every child is closed. Titles, bodies and note text stay in the default foreground.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done: ids cyan on rows, in ties, in the card title and inside 'waits on' (suffix_spans); rollup kept as numbers so it turns green when complete; kind magenta for a milestone; actor() colours a person cyan and an agent magenta on rows, in the about pane and in post borders; pane(title, focused) draws the pane with the cursor plain and bold, the rest dim; headers and the title line bold cyan. fit() became split() over lengths plus cut_spans(), so a cut tail keeps each span's style.
